properties.description: This policy initiative enforces security controls for AI subscriptions, including network isolation, encryption, identity management, authentication, compute security, content filtering, diagnostic logging, and WAF controls for Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Services, Cognitive Services, Azure AI Search, and Application Gateway.

metadata.displayName: Effect - Azure Machine Learning and AI Studio should use Allow Only Approved Outbound Managed Vnet mode
metadata.description: Managed VNet isolation streamlines and automates your network isolation configuration with a built-in, workspace-level Azure Machine Learning managed VNet. To have strict network control on outbound traffic.

metadata.displayName: Effect - Configure Azure Machine Learning workspaces with private endpoints
metadata.description: Configure private endpoints for Azure Machine Learning workspaces. As per deployment/infra configuration of environment.

metadata.displayName: Private Endpoint Subnet ID - Configure Azure ML workspaces with private endpoints
metadata.description: The subnet resource ID for the private endpoint to be created in. As per deployment/infra configuration of environment.

metadata.displayName: Effect - Configure Azure Machine Learning workspace to use private DNS zones
metadata.description: Use private DNS zones to override the DNS resolution for a private endpoint for Azure Machine Learning workspaces. As per deployment/infra configuration of environment.

metadata.displayName: Private DNS Zone ID - Configure Azure ML workspace to use private DNS zones
metadata.description: The private DNS zone resource ID for the first private DNS zone. As per deployment/infra configuration of environment.

metadata.displayName: Second Private DNS Zone ID - Configure Azure ML workspace to use private DNS zones
metadata.description: The private DNS zone resource ID for the second private DNS zone. As per deployment/infra configuration of environment.

metadata.displayName: Effect - [Preview]: Azure Machine Learning Model Registry Deployments are restricted except for the allowed Registry
metadata.description: Restrict ML model registry deployments except for the allowed registry. Will only use OpenAI models for now.

metadata.displayName: Effect - [Preview]: Cognitive Services Deployments should only use allowed completion content filtering

metadata.displayName: Effect - [Preview]: Cognitive Services Deployments should only use allowed control

metadata.displayName: Effect - [Preview]: Cognitive Services Deployments should only use allowed prompt content filtering
metadata.description: Enforce prompt content filtering for Cognitive Services deployments.

metadata.displayName: Effect - Azure AI Services resources should encrypt data at rest with a customer-managed key (CMK)

metadata.displayName: Effect - Cognitive Services Deployments should only use approved Registry Models
metadata.description: Restrict Cognitive Services deployments to only use approved registry models.
